name: warera-plus
description: WarEra Plus: an unofficial, read-only companion for the WarEra browser game (SNIPE and FLIP tags on equipment offers, craft and case values at live prices, a ledger of the player's own crafting, case and trading history).

scripts.format: prettier --write extension scripts README.md CHANGELOG.md docs package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.js .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check extension scripts README.md CHANGELOG.md docs package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.js .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run validate && npm test && npm run format:check
